# FPSOT registry specification

> What software must record and prove about each register of assets, ownership and entitlements that a law establishes, whatever the domain: immutable filings with three dates, three statuses, the filer's authority and a light chain sealed under the signed records specification; state derived by replaying filings, as of one instant and as recorded at another; assets, owner groups, entitlements and encumbrances; field visibility and opposability as separate data; declared search modes and sealed extracts; retention classes and lawful destruction with tombstones; and the law of each jurisdiction kept in versioned profiles.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, conformance classes, legal status, owners of the parts and conformance; REG-001 to REG-006.
- [Jurisdiction profiles](spec/en/profiles.adoc): REG-010 to REG-016.
- [Filings](spec/en/filings.adoc): REG-020 to REG-033.
- [Derived state and history](spec/en/history.adoc): REG-040 to REG-046.
- [Assets, ownership, entitlements and encumbrances](spec/en/assets-rights.adoc): REG-050 to REG-061.
- [Visibility, opposability and access](spec/en/visibility.adoc): REG-070 to REG-077.
- [Search, extracts and credentials](spec/en/search-extracts.adoc): REG-080 to REG-087.
- [Retention and destruction](spec/en/retention.adoc): REG-090 to REG-096.
- [Packs, events and conformance](spec/en/conformance.adoc): REG-100 to REG-108.
- [Alignment with other standards](spec/en/alignment.adoc): informative.
- [Questions for counsel](spec/en/questions-for-counsel.adoc): informative, not legal advice.
